dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge to the apex, exhibiting a distinct falcate curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute triangular tip with a small pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree ascending slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.7:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex curvature of the melon, measured along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, low-profile beak with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.5:1 extending from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle at the pixel transition where the melon curvature meets the rostrum ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense cyan bioluminescent-like glow and high-contrast specular highlights across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
